name: Derrick Levasseur
summary: A strategic mastermind who played a flawless social and strategic game, Derrick managed to never be nominated while controlling most evictions.

name: Cody Calafiore
summary: Part of 'The Hitmen' alliance with Derrick, Cody had strong social ties and won key competitions, ultimately taking Derrick to the final 2.

name: Frankie Grande
summary: Flashy and competitive, Frankie was a strong social and physical player who made several bold moves before being blindsided late in the game.

name: Victoria Rafaeli
summary: Often underestimated, Victoria was protected by Derrick throughout the game and managed to make it far despite not winning many comps.

name: Zach Rance
summary: Energetic and unpredictable, Zach was a fan favorite for his antics and chaos. He played hard and fast but burned bridges quickly.

name: Christine Brecht
summary: Christine was a strategic player with strong ties to the male-dominated Bomb Squad, but her loyalty was questioned by allies and fans alike.

name: Donny Thompson
summary: Beloved for his heart and sincerity, Donny was seen as a threat due to his likability and comp wins, despite being on the outs with the main alliance.

name: Nicole Franzel
summary: Smart and competitive, Nicole tried to lead an opposition to the Bomb Squad but was taken out twice. She later returned in future seasons.

name: Caleb Reynolds
summary: Loyal and physically dominant, Caleb was fiercely loyal to his alliance and excelled in comps, though his romantic fixation on Amber raised eyebrows.

name: Amber Borzotra
summary: Amber was physically capable and socially well-liked, but was targeted early due to her independence and being seen as a threat by the Bomb Squad.
